ns2:section.sectionText: Can NOT use this CRN (10538) to enroll in the course. **Master's students: CRN for instructor will be provided to the student AFTER the required paperwork has been completed, signatures secured, and submitted as instructed. For Master's 599 form, go to http://webdocs.lis.illinois.edu/registration/599form.pdf. **PhD students: inform the office staff of the faculty advisor you are registering with and the CRN for that faculty instructor will be provided.
